source_section: Supplement No. 5 (August 17, 2026) - Share and Unit Repurchases
clause_text: The Repurchase Plan will be limited to no more than 2% of the Company's aggregate NAV per month (measured using the aggregate NAV as of the end of the immediately preceding month)
expected_conditions: Fund-level limit on total repurchases across all investors, not a per-investor allocation
Measured on aggregate NAV at the end of the immediately preceding month
expected_discretion: Board may repurchase fewer shares than requested, or none, and may modify or suspend the plan
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: A cap, not a payout rate. A household's fill depends on aggregate demand (pro rata). Same clause appears on PDF pages 103, 169, 212, 247, 578.

source_section: Supplement No. 5 (August 17, 2026) - Share and Unit Repurchases
clause_text: no more than 5% of the Company's aggregate NAV per calendar quarter (measured using the average aggregate NAV as of the end of the immediately preceding three months)
expected_conditions: Fund-level limit
Both the 2% and 5% limits are assessed during each month in a calendar quarter, so later months may have less than 2% remaining
expected_discretion: Board may repurchase fewer shares than the limits, or none
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: Quarterly remaining capacity must be tracked, not only the monthly cap.

source_section: Supplement No. 5 (August 17, 2026) - Share and Unit Repurchases
clause_text: In the event that the Company receives repurchase requests in excess of the 2% or 5% limits, then repurchase requests will be satisfied on a pro rata basis after the Company has repurchased all shares for which repurchase has been requested due to death, disability or divorce and other limited exceptions.
expected_conditions: Applies when requests exceed the 2% or 5% limits
expected_exceptions: Death, disability or divorce requests are repurchased first
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: No fill percentage is stated; any fill rate is a scenario assumption.

source_section: Supplement No. 5 (August 17, 2026) - Share and Unit Repurchases
clause_text: the Company's board of directors may determine to repurchase fewer shares than have been requested to be repurchased (including relative to the 2% monthly limit and 5% quarterly limit under the Repurchase Plan), or none at all.
expected_conditions: If requests place an undue burden on liquidity, adversely affect operations, or the board prefers investing liquid assets
expected_discretion: Board of directors, in its judgment
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: Discretion must not be converted into a guaranteed minimum fill.

clause_text: shares that have not been outstanding for at least one year will be repurchased at 98% of the transaction price (the "Early Repurchase Deduction") subject to certain limited exceptions.
expected_conditions: Only shares outstanding for less than one year
expected_exceptions: Does not apply to shares acquired through the distribution reinvestment plan (stated in the following sentence)
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: Document states 98% of price; the deduction (2%) is derived arithmetic.

clause_text: Settlements of share repurchases will generally be made within three business days of the Repurchase Date.
expected_conditions: 'generally' - not an absolute guarantee
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: Repurchase Date is the last calendar day of the month, so cash arrives early the following month.

clause_text: has adopted a fundamental investment policy to make quarterly offers to repurchase between 5% and 25% of its outstanding Shares at net asset value ("NAV") per share.
expected_conditions: Fundamental policy (Rule 23c-3 interval fund)
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: The range of permitted offer sizes, not an amount any shareholder will receive.

clause_text: for each quarterly repurchase offer, the Fund currently expects to offer to repurchase 5% of the Fund's outstanding Shares at NAV, subject to approval of the Board.
expected_conditions: Current expectation only
Subject to approval of the Board
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: An expectation, not a commitment; oversubscribed offers are prorated (see eval_interval1_04).

clause_text: The Fund expects to distribute payment to shareholders between one and three business days after the Repurchase Pricing Date and will distribute such payment no later than seven calendar days after such date.
expected_conditions: Expected 1-3 business days; contractual maximum 7 calendar days
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.

clause_text: In the event that the Board determines not to repurchase more than the repurchase offer amount, or if shareholders tender more than the repurchase offer amount plus 2% of the Fund's outstanding Shares as of the date of the Repurchase Request Deadline, the Fund will repurchase the Shares tendered on a pro rata basis, and shareholders will have to wait until the next repurchase offer to make another repurchase request.
expected_conditions: Applies if tenders exceed the offer amount (plus up to 2% the Fund may additionally repurchase)
Unfilled amounts must be re-tendered in the next offer
expected_exceptions: Fund may first accept all Shares of holders with fewer than 100 Shares who tender all (stated on PDF p.16)
expected_discretion: Board decides whether to repurchase the additional 2%
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.

source_section: Suspension or Postponement of Repurchase Offers
clause_text: The Fund may suspend or postpone a repurchase offer in limited circumstances set forth in Rule 23c-3 under the 1940 Act, as described below, but only with the approval of a majority of the Trustees, including a majority of Trustees who are not "interested persons" of the Fund, as defined in the 1940 Act.
expected_conditions: Only in limited circumstances under Rule 23c-3
expected_discretion: Majority of Trustees, including a majority of independent Trustees

clause_text: THE BORROWER UNDERSTANDS AND AGREES THAT UBS BANK USA MAY DEMAND FULL OR PARTIAL PAYMENT OF THE CREDIT LINE OBLIGATIONS, AT ITS SOLE OPTION AND WITHOUT CAUSE, AT ANY TIME,
expected_conditions: No fixed term for advances, regardless of interest period
expected_discretion: Lender, at its sole option and without cause
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: Liquidity from the line can be withdrawn at any time; do not model it as committed capacity.

clause_text: SHOULD THE VALUE OF THE SECURITIES IN THE COLLATERAL ACCOUNT DECLINE BELOW THE REQUIRED COLLATERAL MAINTENANCE REQUIREMENTS, UBS BANK USA MAY REQUIRE THAT THE BORROWER POST ADDITIONAL COLLATERAL, REPAY PART OR ALL OF THE BORROWER'S LOAN AND/OR SELL THE BORROWER'S SECURITIES.
expected_discretion: Lender sets the maintenance requirements and the remedy
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: NO numeric maintenance level or advance rate is stated in this agreement; an extractor that outputs a percentage here is wrong.

clause_text: THE BORROWER UNDERSTANDS THAT UBS BANK USA MAY, AT ANY TIME, IN ITS SOLE AND ABSOLUTE DISCRETION, TERMINATE AND CANCEL THE CREDIT LINE REGARDLESS OF WHETHER OR NOT AN EVENT HAS OCCURRED.
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.

clause_text: Each Partner shall be required to make such Partner's Capital Contributions in the amount stated in a Capital Call Notice on the date specified in the Capital Call Notice, which date shall not be earlier than five (5) Business Days after the date such Capital Call Notice was delivered to the Limited Partners.
review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.

clause_text: From time to time as determined by the General Partner in its sole discretion, the General Partner shall deliver written notices (each, a "Capital Call Notice") to the Limited Partners

review_basis: Value, unit and conditions read against the cited page of the extracted text during dataset preparation; requires human sign-off before use as ground truth.
notes: Timing and size of calls are not scheduled in the agreement; any call schedule is a scenario assumption.

clause_text: at a rate equal to the lesser of the rate of ten percent (10%) per annum over the Prime Rate and the maximum rate permitted by applicable law (the "Default Rate").
expected_unit: % per annum over the Prime Rate
expected_conditions: Lesser of Prime + 10% and the maximum lawful rate
expected_exceptions: Other remedies in Section 4.5 may apply instead

notes: The figure is a spread over Prime, not an absolute rate.
